entries.rationale: Tailwind 3 build dependency. Vulnerable braces execution observed only during trusted production compilation using repository-controlled content globs. No execution in backend, worker, Nginx runtime or inspected browser artifact. Production users cannot control the patterns supplied to braces. Reviewed 2026-10-11 for the shared closure GitHub verifier binding: only the read-only verifier dependency, explicit hosted workflow-token bindings and mocked consumer regression tests change. Frontend source, dependency locks, runtime packaging and build patterns are unchanged; canonical browser closure and runtime packaging were independently revalidated against the retained unfiltered hosted OSV report. Reviewed 2026-10-12 for full-capacity IAM no-op continuation: the change affects only coordinator planning, evidence checks, tests and operations documentation. The lockfiles, frontend source/build patterns and runtime packaging are unchanged; the unfiltered OSV scan still reports only the existing dev-only braces advisory, and a canonical browser build excludes braces. Reviewed 2026-10-12 for phase-local no-op policy artifact identity: only the production coordinator and mocked test change. Exact-branch OSV reports the same build-only braces finding; package locks, browser source, build patterns and runtime packaging are unchanged from protected main's passing canonical closure. Reviewed 2026-10-12 for authenticated Release Train gate retries: only the hosted coordinator's exact-run attempt validation and its tests change. The exact-branch unfiltered scan still reports only dev-only braces@3.0.3; the package locks, browser source, build patterns and runtime packaging are unchanged. The accepted scope, owner and expiry remain unchanged. Reviewed 2026-10-13 for skipped-pruning approval polling: only the release coordinator, mocked test and operations documentation change. Repository-controlled build globs, application source, dependency locks and runtime packaging are unchanged; exact-main unfiltered OSV and browser closure show the same dev-only braces finding absent from runtime. Reviewed 2026-10-13 for post-publication output reconciliation and runner restart: only the Stage B broker verifier, the existing coordinator evidence capsule, mocked regression tests and operations documentation change. Protected-main audit run 38326545736 reported only the same dev-only braces advisory and canonical browser closure excluded braces across 204 packages. Frontend code, content globs, lockfiles, browser packaging and the accepted scope remain unchanged; exact-head CI must revalidate the scan and browser closure. Reviewed 2026-10-13 for successor START namespace isolation: only release coordinator START selection, protected authorization lookup, and mocked tests changed. The exact-branch OSV 2.6.0 unfiltered scan still finds only dev-only braces@3.0.3; the canonical browser closure contains 204 packages and excludes braces. Dependency locks, frontend source, build globs, runtime packaging, acceptance scope, owner, and expiry remain unchanged. Reviewed 2026-10-13 for the exact v14 successor Terraform lifecycle snapshot: only the state-history verifier, focused tests, and operations documentation change. OSV Scanner 2.6.0 still finds only dev-only braces@3.0.3; the canonical browser closure excludes braces. The accepted scope, owner, and expiry remain unchanged. Reviewed 2026-10-13 for authenticated adoption of an independently completed broker closure: only the release coordinator, hosted evidence locator, mocked regression tests and operations documentation changed. The exact-branch unfiltered OSV 2.6.0 scan still reports only dev-only braces@3.0.3. The canonical browser closure contains 204 packages and excludes braces; backend, worker, Nginx runtime, content globs, dependency locks and acceptance scope are unchanged.
